April 13, 2018 - By olga 
Matthew Tewksbury increased its stake in Brunswick Corp (BC) by 30.28% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stevens Capital Management Lp bought 6,312 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.93% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Matthew Tewksbury held 27,157 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.50M, up from 20,845 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stevens Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Brunswick Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.21B market cap company. The stock increased 0.78% or $0.46 during the last trading session, reaching $59.59. About 760,133 shares traded. Brunswick Corporation (NYSE:BC) has declined 3.37% since April 13, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.92% the S&P500.

Noesis Capital Mangement Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $883.59B market cap company. The stock increased 0.99% or $1.7 during the last trading session, reaching $174.14. About 21.10 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.

It also reduced its holding in Berry Global Group Inc (NYSE:BERY) by 86,490 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 28,987 shares, and cut its stake in Sempra Energy (NYSE:SRE).
